title_en: Nagoya Chita Peninsula: A Luxury Cultural Escape in Central Japan
title_cn: 名古屋·知多半岛：中部日本奢华文化之旅
subtitle_en: A premium experience showcasing the culture, nature, cuisine, and craftsmanship of Nagoya and the Chita Peninsula.

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 595,000, 3 pax 440,000, 4 pax 370,000, 5 pax 350,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: A Day of Tradition and Taste in Nagoya
days_detail.activities: After arriving at Nagoya Station or Centrair Airport, travel to Miwa Shrine by private car. Enjoy a unique cultural experience by meeting a goshuin designer and trying your hand at traditional printmaking. Then, have lunch and explore the lively Osu Shopping Street. In the afternoon, take a guided tour of Nagoya Castle and the beautifully restored Honmaru Palace. End the day with a dinner of modern Japanese cuisine.

days_detail.title: Explore the Beauty of Nature and the Wonder of Ghibli
days_detail.activities: Enjoy a nature-filled tour that includes a stop at a teahouse in Higashiyama Botanical Garden or Farm Aichi. Stroll through popular areas of Ghibli Park, such as “Mononoke no Sato,” and have lunch at a Ghibli-themed restaurant. It’s a day to immerse yourself in the charm of Japan’s four seasons and the magic of anime.

days_detail.title: Slip Into the Past: A Day of Culture and Elegance in Inuyama
days_detail.activities: Travel to Inuyama in the comfort of a private car, where tradition and charm await. Begin your day by changing into a kimono and strolling through the atmospheric castle town, culminating in a visit to Inuyama Castle—one of Japan’s oldest wooden fortresses. Enjoy a thoughtfully crafted Japanese lunch made with local, seasonal ingredients. In the afternoon, head to Meiji Mura (Meiji Village), where a private guide will walk you through Japan’s Meiji-era history amid beautifully preserved architecture—perfect for immersive storytelling and picturesque snapshots.

days_detail.title: A Scenic Escape to Chita: Craft, Cuisine, and Coastal Charm
days_detail.activities: Travel to the Chita Peninsula by private car and enjoy a hands-on experience baking shrimp crackers at Ebisenbei no Sato. For those interested, a visit to Tokoname offers a pottery walk and the opportunity to try your hand at traditional ceramics. Lunch features fresh seafood served right by the beach. In the afternoon, explore Flight of Dreams at Centrair Airport before concluding the tour at your leisure.

title_en: Aomori Unveiled: Culture of Mountain and Sea at Japan’s Northern Edge
title_cn: 青森全览：本州最北端的山海文化
subtitle_en: 7-Day Journey to Japan’s Northern Edge: Nature, Spirituality, and Culinary Traditions

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 1,350,000, 3 pax 1,180,000, 4 pax 1,110,000, 5 pax 980,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: A Tranquil Start: Forest Walks and Hot Springs in Hakkōda
days_detail.activities: Why not begin your journey from Aomori Airport or Shin-Aomori Station by heading into the serene forests of Hakkōda and Oirase? As you walk beneath dappled sunlight and listen to the murmuring of mountain streams, you may find yourself gently slipping away from the routines of daily life. At sunset, unwind at a hot spring inn nestled in nature, where you can savour a seasonal dinner crafted from the region’s finest ingredients.

days_detail.title: A journey through culture and waterscapes — where time gently unravels between castle ruins and a quiet lakeshore.
days_detail.activities: Consider visiting cultural landmarks such as Hirosaki Castle or the Sannai-Maruyama Archaeological Site. As you wander through a castle town that transforms with the seasons, or reflect on the ancient lives once lived here, a quiet moment of connection may naturally become part of your journey. In the evening, pause at Tsuru-no-Mai Bridge or along the shores of Lake Jūsan. In the fading light, you can savour a gentle stillness carried by the wind and water.

days_detail.title: Where Cliffs Meet Calm: A Journey to Ōma and Hotokegaura
days_detail.activities: As one option for the journey, we suggest crossing the Tsugaru Strait to explore the Shimokita Peninsula. Along the way, you can stop to admire the dramatic rock formations of Hotokegaura and take in the tranquil beauty of the rustic fishing town of Ōma. Here, time flows gently, shaped by daily life and the quiet strength of nature. For your overnight stay, we recommend Ōma Shukubō Fugen-in, a temple lodging offering a fully private experience. Nestled within a vast 3,000-tsubo (about 10,000-square-meter) temple ground, the main hall—crafted entirely from Aomori Hiba wood—provides a serene setting for deeply restorative temple experiences, including Buddha statue polishing (kanmoku), sutra tracing (shabutsu), seated meditation (zazen), and prayer rituals (gokitō). Dinner features a sumptuous selection of local cuisine, including the famed Ōma tuna, all enjoyed over relaxed conversation with the head monk—accompanied by all-you-can-drink beverages. This is an evening to fully embrace the essence of “slow temple life”, a gentle experience that nourishes both body and soul.

days_detail.title: Through the Winds of Sacred Grounds – Beyond the mist, a landscape that leaves you speechless.
days_detail.activities: After enjoying a peaceful morning meal of traditional Japanese Buddhist vegetarian cuisine known as Shojin Ryori, carefully prepared from seasonal, plant-based ingredients, we recommend heading toward the sacred site of Mount Osore (Osorezan). Standing amidst the volcanic, desolate landscape offers a unique and profound experience that can only be felt by simply being there. Afterwards, you may travel to Hachinohe, where you can unwind by visiting local cafes and craft galleries. These spaces offer a quiet blend of everyday life and art, providing a perfect opportunity to relax and refresh your mind.

days_detail.title: Discover the Soul of Aomori: A Day of Craftsmanship and Local Life
days_detail.activities: On this day, we can incorporate experiences that connect you with craftsmanship and local life as part of the journey’s “white space.” Choose from activities such as painting traditional Tsugaru Kokeshi dolls, indigo dyeing, working on a local farm, or preparing regional dishes—each tailored to the traveller’s interests. While the day may be quiet, it’s likely to bring memorable encounters that linger long after.

days_detail.title: Hachinohe: Morning Markets and Quiet Coastal Walks
days_detail.activities: One option is to visit the morning market in Hachinohe, where you can immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the locals. The fresh ingredients and vibrant sounds of the market will add colour to your travel experience. In the afternoon, take a walk through the serene nature of Kabushima Island, where seagulls dance, or stroll through the meadows of Tanesashi Coast for a tranquil connection with the outdoors. You might find yourself spending a quiet day, listening closely to the sound of the wind.

days_detail.title: Savouring the Final Moments: A Quiet Day in Aomori and Hachinohe
days_detail.activities: On the final day, consider leaving the schedule open to visit cafes, galleries, or small craft shops in Aomori or Hachinohe. This will allow you to savour the quiet moments of your journey. As you make your way to the airport or station, a final cup of coffee, a piece of fabric, or a book could provide a “humble encounter” that gently wraps up your memories of the trip.

title_en: Discover Fukuoka: Gateway to Asia, Heart of Japan
title_cn: 发现福冈：亚洲门户、日本之心
subtitle_en: Experience the best of Fukuoka in one unforgettable tour—scenic coastlines, vibrant flowers, local textiles, juicy fruits, and historic World Heritage sites.

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 1,140,000, 3 pax 860,000, 4 pax 720,000, 5 pax 640,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: Arrival to Itoshima: A Scenic Start to Your Kyushu Getaway
days_detail.activities: After arriving at the airport, head west to explore artists’ studios, seaside galleries, and cosy cafés. Watch the sunset at Meoto Iwa (Sakurai Futamigaura) at dusk, then enjoy an overnight stay at a seaside resort in Itoshima.

days_detail.title: Kurume in a Day: Weaving, Sake, and Seasonal Flavours
days_detail.activities: Head to Kurume and experience traditional weaving at a craft studio specialising in Kurume Kasuri. In the afternoon, enjoy a tour and tasting at a local sake brewery. In the evening, savour creative kaiseki cuisine made with local seasonal ingredients. Spend the night at a quaint inn in Kurume.

days_detail.title: Discover the Charm of Ukiha: From Orchards to Old Towns
days_detail.activities: Experience seasonal fruit picking in the “fruit kingdom” of Ukiha. After a stroll through its charming white-walled streets, take a moment to calm your mind at the sacred Ukihane Inari Shrine. Stay overnight in a rented traditional house and enjoy homemade local cuisine.

days_detail.title: Explore Munakata Taisha and Unwind in a Hot Spring Inn
days_detail.activities: Visit the World Heritage Site Munakata Taisha Shrine, followed by a stop at the nearby museum. After enjoying a dinner made with local ingredients, relax and stay overnight at a hot spring inn.

days_detail.title: Fukuoka Adventure: Seasonal Flowers and City Lights
days_detail.activities: Enjoy a stroll through the seaside town of Fukutsu, taking in the beauty of seasonal flowers. In the afternoon, return to Fukuoka City for shopping and a taste of local cuisine.

days_detail.title: The Last Day of Your Fukuoka Journey
days_detail.activities: After a visit to Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine, enjoy some shopping and a final lunch before heading to the airport for your journey home.

title_en: Eastern Nagano Escape: A Journey into Japan’s Serene Highlands and Cultural Elegance
title_cn: 东信州之旅：静谧高原与雅致文化

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 715,000, 3 pax 650,000, 4 pax 617,500, 5 pax 585,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: Karuizawa Awakens: Waterfalls by Day, Wildlife by Night
days_detail.activities: We recommend starting your journey in Karuizawa, a scenic highland resort just an hour from Tokyo by bullet train. We recommended starting off your trip at Shiraito Falls, where the enchanting sound of cascading water brings a moment of serenity. Wrapped in the mist of the falls, you feel the immense power of nature unfolding before you, as if stepping into an entirely new world. In the evening, embark on an exclusive guided night walk through the forests of Karuizawa. Led by a specially selected private guide, you’ll have the rare opportunity to encounter wildlife seldom seen in everyday life — an immersive experience that feels truly extraordinary.

days_detail.title: A Day of Wonder in Saku & Karuizawa
days_detail.activities: We invite you to begin your day at dawn with a hot air balloon ride, gently lifting you into the vast skies over Saku. As you rise, the stunning Nagano landscape stretches out beneath you—serene, expansive, and unforgettable. After your flight, feel the refreshing breeze of Karuizawa as you explore the charming town on an eBike. Cruise freely along scenic paths where nature and history intertwine, passing by quaint architecture and lush greenery. As evening falls, we recommend treating yourself to a rejuvenating escape at a luxury resort hotel’s spa. Sink into the soothing warmth of a hot spring and let your worries melt away—the perfect way to reset both body and mind.

days_detail.title: Takamine Highlands: A Sky-High Escape into Nature
days_detail.activities: Immerse yourself in the breathtaking scenery of Takamine Highlands, situated 2,000 meters above sea level. Here, you might spot wild Japanese serows and discover a vibrant array of alpine plants that bloom in harmony with the seasons. Delight in seasonal outdoor activities and savour the rich flavors of the region’s mountain cuisine. As night falls, the sky over Takamine transforms into a dazzling spectacle of stars, offering a truly unforgettable close to your day in nature.

days_detail.title: Wine & Farmhouse Retreat in Nagano
days_detail.activities: Enjoy an exclusive experience at a prestigious Shinshu winery (Shinshu is the traditional name for Nagano), followed by seasonal agricultural activities such as harvesting, planting, and cooking with fresh local ingredients. Stay in a beautifully restored traditional farmhouse, offering an immersive retreat that awakens the senses.

days_detail.title: Farewell from Karuizawa
days_detail.activities: Before heading to Karuizawa Station, enjoy a heartwarming breakfast and breathe in the crisp morning air during a final stroll through the picturesque streets. A private vehicle will then take you to the station, where you will bid farewell and bring this memorable trip to a close.

title_cn: 长野尊享静养之旅（南信州）
subtitle_en: A luxury retreat, from indulgent ryokan stays and tranquil lakes to exquisite gourmet delights.

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 1,030,000, 3 pax 770,000, 4 pax 650,000, 5 pax 580,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: A Day in Matsumoto: Castles, Traditional Streets & Onsen
days_detail.activities: Easily accessible by express train from Tokyo or Nagoya, or via flights into Matsumoto Airport, this journey begins in the historical city of Matsumoto. Upon arriving at Matsumoto Station (or Airport), take a private car to Matsumoto Castle, a national treasure affectionately known as the “Crow Castle.” You may explore its historic grounds while taking in breathtaking views of the Northern Alps. Then, stroll through the charming Nakamachi Street, where traditional crafts and local delicacies await. In the afternoon, check in at Tobira Onsen Myojinkan, nestled at an altitude of 1,050 meters. You may unwind in serene hot springs surrounded by nature and indulge in a kaiseki dinner featuring seasonal ingredients from the Nagano region.

days_detail.title: Nature activity：Fujimi Panorama Resort
Suwa Five Sake Brewery Tour
days_detail.activities: The “Suwa Five Sake Brewery Tour” offers a unique experience where you can stroll between five historic sake breweries, all within walking distance, and sample a variety of distinctive Japanese sakes. With the “Gokuraku Set”—which includes an original glass, a drawstring pouch, and limited-edition stickers, the tour becomes even more enjoyable. Beyond the breweries, you can explore the charming townscape, visit the lake and local shrines, and discover other attractions that capture the essence of Suwa. In the afternoon, continue to Ina and relax at a tranquil hot spring ryokan.

days_detail.title: Southern Nagano Escape: Farm-to-Table Experience & Mountain Scenic Views
days_detail.activities: We suggest joining local farmers for a hands-on experience in immersing yourself in the rural charm of Southern Nagano by harvesting seasonal vegetables alongside local farmers. Then, prepare traditional Shinshu dishes using your fresh harvest. In the afternoon, ride a gondola to a scenic plateau at 1,780 meters, where you can enjoy afternoon tea and forest bathing with breathtaking views of Mount Fuji and the Yatsugatake Mountains. End the day with a relaxing overnight stay at Hirugami Onsen.

days_detail.title: Southern Nagano: Stargazing & Hot Springs Escape
days_detail.activities: We invite you to start your adventure with a stroll through Hirugami Onsen village, soaking in the scenic beauty of one of the region’s top hot spring areas and the charm of the quaint town. In the afternoon, head to Achi Village for a stargazing tour, where you can experience Japan’s most breathtaking starry sky. The shimmering stars create a surreal atmosphere, offering a truly unique experience. In the evening, unwind at Hirugami Onsen, indulge in the skin-beautifying hot springs, and savour a meal made with local ingredients that refresh both body and mind.

days_detail.title: Kiso: A Journey Through History & Tradition
days_detail.activities: You may explore the rich history and culture of Kiso as we explore the historic post town of Kiso-Fukushima. Immerse yourself in the area’s heritage, including a hands-on traditional craft experience.

days_detail.title: Alpine Views & Scenic Farewell in Komagane
days_detail.activities: On the final day, head to Komagane and take the ropeway to Senjojiki Cirque to enjoy the scenic views. Relax over lunch and café time at a mountain resort surrounded by alpine plants. Afterward, transfer to Matsumoto Station(Airport) by private car to conclude the tour.

title_en: Tochigi in Four Days: World Heritage, Hot Springs & Cultural Charms
title_cn: 栃木 4 天：世界遗产、温泉与文化魅力
subtitle_en: 4 days A sophisticated 4-day journey for adults, combining historic landmarks, natural beauty, traditional culture, and rejuvenating hot springs

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 710,000, 3 pax 550,000, 4 pax 460,000, 5 pax 400,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: Nikko in a Day: Heritage Sites, Yuba Delights & Hot Spring Retreat
days_detail.activities: In the morning, travel from Tokyo Station to Nikko by JR or Tobu Railway express train (approximately 2 hours). Begin your visit with World Heritage sites such as Nikko Toshogu Shrine, Rinno-ji Temple, and Futarasan Shrine (a guide can be arranged upon request). For lunch, enjoy Nikko’s specialty, yuba cuisine. In the afternoon, take a peaceful stroll around Kanmangafuchi and the row of Bake Jizo statues, a quieter area with fewer tourists. Spend the night at a high-quality hot spring inn in Nikko Onsen, where you can unwind in a relaxing open-air bath.

days_detail.title: Escape to Oku-Nikko: Hiking, Heritage, and Hot Springs Retreat
days_detail.activities: In the morning, cross the Irohazaka Pass and head to Oku-Nikko. Visit Lake Chuzenji and Kegon Falls, then enjoy lunch at a lakeside restaurant. In summer, treat yourself to shaved ice made from natural ice. In the afternoon, take a light hike through Senjogahara (a guide is available) and stop by Takio Shrine, known for its serene, moss-covered approach. In the evening, stay overnight at an inn in Yumoto Onsen, famous for its sulfur springs, and unwind in the peaceful natural surroundings.

days_detail.title: A Cultural Day Trip through Utsunomiya, Kanuma, and Tochigi
days_detail.activities: Start your day in Utsunomiya with a visit to the awe-inspiring underground quarry at the Oya History Museum, a unique space carved from ancient stone. For lunch, treat yourself to a gyoza-tasting adventure at one of the city’s famed dumpling spots. In the afternoon, continue to Kanuma and immerse yourself in the elegance of Kanuma Kumiko, a traditional woodworking craft. As evening falls, make your way to Tochigi City to unwind at a temple-style inn and savour a thoughtfully prepared dinner featuring seasonal, local ingredients.

days_detail.title: Historic Charm and Scenic Farewell in Tochigi
days_detail.activities: Begin your day with a peaceful stroll along the traditional storehouses lining the Uwa River, or opt for a relaxing boat ride. Then, explore seasonal blooms and spiritual sites like Taihei-san Shrine and the picturesque Hydrangea Hill. For lunch, unwind at a cosy machiya café or a local eatery serving regional flavours. In the afternoon, return to Tokyo from Tochigi Station—a scenic journey of about 90 minutes.

title_en: Discover Osaka: City Adventures, Skyline Views and Cultural Experiences
title_cn: 发现大阪：都市探索、天际线与文化体验
subtitle_en: Cultural and City Life Experiences, Culinary Wonders, and Sightseeing

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 770,000, 3 pax 520,000, 4 pax 390,000, 5 pax 585,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: A Scenic Beginning: Balloon Views over Ancient Osaka
days_detail.activities: Start your journey with a breathtaking balloon flight offering panoramic views of Osaka’s ancient kofun tombs, an unforgettable perspective that connects you to the region’s deep history from the very first day. After landing, take a leisurely stroll or simply relax and take in the peaceful surroundings of Sakai. This calm yet awe-inspiring introduction sets the perfect tone for the cultural experiences that await in the days ahead.

days_detail.title: From Bladesmithing to Botanical Beauty
days_detail.activities: Journey to Sakai, a city renowned for its centuries-old knife-making legacy. Step into the workshop of a master blacksmith and witness the meticulous craftsmanship that brings Sakai knives to life. For a truly memorable experience, join a hands-on session to forge your very own custom blade—a unique keepsake infused with tradition and skill. In the afternoon, uncover the city’s ancient past as you wander through majestic kofun burial mounds, silent testaments to Japan’s rich heritage. As dusk settles, unwind at the tranquil Nagai Botanical Gardens, where TeamLab’s enchanting digital art installations bathe the surroundings in a dreamlike harmony of light, nature, and innovation.

days_detail.title: A Taste of Elegance: Tea, Wagashi & Kaiseki in Sakai
days_detail.activities: Begin your day in Sakai City with a hands-on wagashi (Japanese confectionery) workshop at Maruichi Kashiho, a beloved establishment founded in 1895. Under the guidance of skilled artisans, you’ll shape delicate seasonal sweets using their signature house-made bean paste. Don’t miss their celebrated Kurumi Mochi — a highlight honored at the Japan Pavilion for Expo 2025 Osaka-Kansai.​ Next, step into the past at the Sakai Plaza of Rikyu and Akiko, nestled near the former residence of the revered tea master Sen no Rikyū. Immerse yourself in a traditional tea ceremony within a serene Ryurei-style tea room, savoring matcha paired with the wagashi you crafted earlier. ​ As evening sets in, conclude your cultural journey with an elegant kaiseki dinner — a multi-course feast that celebrates the essence of Japanese cuisine through seasonal flavors, thoughtful presentation, and culinary artistry.

days_detail.title: Exploring Osaka’s Blossoms, History & City Life
days_detail.activities: Begin your morning with a tranquil stroll through the seasonal blooms of Expo ’70 Commemorative Park — a serene start that sets the tone for the day. Then, journey back in time at Osaka Castle and Toyokuni Shrine, where centuries of history unfold amid majestic architecture and quiet reverence. In the afternoon, immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of Kuromon Market. Sample an array of local delicacies, from freshly grilled seafood to sweet treats. Continue on to Dotonbori, where neon lights, sizzling street food, and the iconic Glico sign offer the perfect backdrop for unforgettable snapshots. As evening falls, you may end your day on a magical note with a scenic river cruise — a dreamy way to watch Osaka shimmer under the night sky.

days_detail.title: Sumo Experience in Izumisano
days_detail.activities: Embark on a cultural journey to Izumisano City for an unforgettable sumo experience. You can observe the strength and refined technique of sumo wrestlers up close as they demonstrate this centuries-old tradition. After the match, you can mingle with the wrestlers and snap a few memorable photos to mark the moment. Savour a hearty bowl of Chanko Nabe — the soul-warming stew beloved by sumo wrestlers — for lunch. Afterwards, enjoy some leisurely free time to explore or unwind before returning to your hotel for a well-deserved rest.

title_cn: 东北尊享美食之旅：大间金枪鱼与下北半岛

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 872,113, 3 pax 678,363, 4 pax 581,488 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.activities: Start the Tour in Aomori City → Travel to Shimokita – A Welcome Dinner and a Quiet Departure Start your Aomori tour itinerary in Aomori City or meet directly at the airport, then travel to the scenic Shimokita area by private car. On the first night of this exclusive Japan tour, enjoy a welcome dinner featuring a special course curated by Chef Nozaki. Accommodation will be at a high-quality inn in Shimokita, providing traditional ryokan comfort and hospitality.

Experience line fishing with an Ōma fisherman, followed by a sushi lunch. In the afternoon, visit the temple lodging Fugen-in to immerse yourself in the natural and spiritual culture of Shimokita. Dinner will be a traditional vegetarian kaiseki meal.

After a tranquil morning ritual and traditional vegetarian breakfast at a historic temple lodging, travel to Aomori City. Dive into the vibrant world of Nebuta through interactive workshops, including festival dancing and music performances. End your day at ReLabo Aomori, a wellness-focused hotel by the Jikeikai Medical Group. Although rated as a 3-star hotel, it has earned top international wellness awards and is highly praised by guests for its comfort, concept, and thoughtful hospitality.

Aomori → Sendai – A Gourmet Journey and a Celebratory Evening Travel south to Sendai, enjoying the natural beauty and stopping by the wineries of Akiu along the way. The day ends with a fusion Japanese dinner at the famous Shozan restaurant. Spend the night at The Westin Sendai, a luxurious five-star hotel.
Free Time in Sendai → Disband Enjoy free time in the morning. This Japan tour concludes with drop-off at Sendai Station or the airport in the afternoon.

title_en: Explore Sado: A 4-Day Private Tour of Nature, Culture, and History
title_cn: 探索佐渡：4 天私人自然·文化·历史之旅
subtitle_en: Enjoy quality time exploring the nature and culture of Sado, a candidate for World Heritage status

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 2 pax 548,000, 3 pax 468,000, 4 pax 418,000, 5 pax 388,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: From City to Shore: Discover the Tranquility of Sado Island
days_detail.activities:
Your Japan Navi Journey begins in the Niigata region, setting off on an exclusive adventure to Sado Island（*Sadoga-shima）—a pristine hidden gem visited by few, even among Japanese travelers.

After a private vehicle transfer to the port and a scenic ferry ride across the sea, you will check into an ocean-view ryokan or resort. Spend the afternoon leisurely discovering the island’s rich cultural landmarks and seasonal natural beauty. As night falls, we can arrange an optional stargazing experience beneath crystal-clear island skies. After a travel-filled first day, take time to unwind and enjoy a restful evening.

days_detail.title: Exploring Sado’s Scenic and Historic Treasures
days_detail.activities: Take an in-depth tour of the Sado Gold Mine, a UNESCO World Heritage Site candidate. In the afternoon, head to Onogame and Futatsugame, scenic spots where the sea and rice terraces intertwine. Let yourself surrender to the rhythm of nature and enjoy the leisurely flow of time.

days_detail.title: A Day of Waves, Crafts, and Cultural Wonders
days_detail.activities: Experience maritime activities unique to Sado, such as a clear-water cruise, tub boat ride, or kayaking. You can also immerse yourself in cultural experiences like traditional crafts and Noh theater. At dusk, visit scenic photo spots featuring rice terraces and fishing villages.

days_detail.title: Island Mornings & Meaningful Moments Before Departure
days_detail.activities: In the early morning, experience island life by observing the Japanese Crested Ibis and strolling through the local morning market. Then, enjoy a special dish for your final lunch. Before your ferry departure, we will drop you off at the port with a few scenic stops along the tranquil seaside. Pick-up and drop-off times can be flexibly arranged based on your ferry schedule.

title_en: Slow Travel in Tsugaru — 3 Days, 2 Nights at an Onsen Ryokan Beneath Mt. Iwaki
title_cn: 津轻慢旅：岩木山下温泉旅馆 3 天 2 晚

price.note: JPY per person, from; by group size: 1 pax 560,000, 2 pax 320,000, 3 pax 240,000, 4 pax 200,000, 5 pax 170,000 (sample quotation incl. private vehicle, guide, hotels & meals)

days_detail.title: Shin-Aomori Station → Hirosaki Apple Park
days_detail.activities: Travel to Hirosaki by private vehicle. At Hirosaki Apple Park, home to around 65 varieties of apples, you can pick apples and enjoy them fresh from the orchard. At the park’s “kimori” workshop, you can also sample cider made with local apples. The orchards also offer views of Mt. Iwaki in the background, making this a great spot for photos.

days_detail.title: Into Shirakami-Sanchi in the Early Morning — A Quiet Morning in the World Natural Heritage Site
days_detail.activities: Set out by private vehicle early in the morning and arrive at Shirakami-Sanchi, a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site, during the quieter hours of the day. In Nishimeya Village, take a guided walk through the beech forests and explore the natural surroundings of this protected area. You will also visit Lake Tsugaru-Shirakami, surrounded by mountains and forests. Depending on the season and weather conditions, a canoe experience on the lake can also be arranged.

days_detail.title: A Morning Stroll around Iwakiyama-jinja Shrine and Momozawa
days_detail.activities: On the final morning, take a stroll around the ryokan and visit the nearby Iwakiyama-jinja Shrine, located at the foot of Mt. Iwaki. Enjoy some time exploring the peaceful surroundings before continuing your journey.

days_detail.title: Shinkansen Journey to Akita
days_detail.activities: Board the Komachi Shinkansen and travel through snowy landscapes to Kakunodate.

days_detail.title: Scenic Drive past Lake Tazawa
days_detail.activities: Travel by private vehicle around the quiet, snow-covered shores of Lake Tazawa.

days_detail.title: Bullet Train to Aomori
days_detail.activities: Travel north via Morioka aboard the Shinkansen to Aomori City.

days_detail.title: Mt. Hakkoda Ropeway
days_detail.activities: Ascend Mt. Hakkoda to witness the spectacular “Snow Monsters” (Juhyo)—giant trees covered in heavy frost and snow.

days_detail.title: Aizu Heritage Tour
days_detail.activities: Explore snow-covered Tsuruga Castle, the unique double-helix wooden architecture of Sazae-do Temple, and historic samurai manors.

days_detail.title: Ouchi-juku Post Town
days_detail.activities: Visit Ouchi-juku, a preserved Edo-period post town nestled in the snow, and enjoy a unique lunch of Negi Soba (eaten using a whole green onion as chopsticks).

days_detail.title: Matsushima Cruise & Oyster Feast
days_detail.activities: Excursion to Matsushima Bay—one of Japan’s Three Most Scenic Views. Board a heated cruise boat and enjoy an all-you-can-eat grilled oyster lunch.

days_detail.title: Nikka Whisky Miyagikyo Distillery
days_detail.activities: Enjoy a guided distillery tour and whisky tasting in the scenic red-brick surroundings of Miyagikyo.

days_detail.title: Return to Tokyo
days_detail.activities: Take the Hayabusa Shinkansen back to Tokyo in the morning.

days_detail.title: Final Morning
days_detail.activities: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast at a trendy café followed by last-minute tax-free shopping.
